text:
sam: FYI — noticed a regression in Mistral-7B GQA throughput after yesterday's kernel selector change. ~18% drop at 512-context p50 throughput. anyone else seeing this?

jia: saw it on our staging runs as well. quick flamegraph shows more time in memcpy + KV pager. :eyes:

marco: @sam which kernel flip was that? did we switch GEMM paths or change packing?

sam: we flipped the GEMM path selection for rotary dims > 64 to the tensor kernel (was amx). change was to accommodate RoPE scaling logic for Mixtral/Qwen.

olga: interesting — Mixtral and Qwen have different rotary dim layouts; selector probably mis-triggered for Mistral variants. Could be the reason the kernel chosen is slower on our hw.

perf-bot: perf-bot: nightly perf test #879 failed threshold for mistral-7b-gqa (throughput -19%).

jia: short profile excerpt:
```
Mistral-7B GQA @512 ctx
time breakdown (median):
  GEMM         42%   (+12% vs baseline)
  KV pager     18%   (+9%)
  memcpy       14%   (+10%)
kv page faults: 320 -> 780 /sec
page eviction churn high when cache hit rate < 0.72
```

marco: current KV layout: page_size=128 entries, num_key_value_heads=16, kv_dim=128. If fragmentation increases, the pager trips and memcpy spikes. Two levers: change page_size or change head/dim packing so pages align to hardware vector lanes.

sam: propose experiments: (A) num_key_value_heads=32 + kv_dim=64, (B) page_size=256, (C) force interleaved head layout, (D) force fallback kernel to amx for mistral-7b.

jia: I'll queue a grid for A/B/C. Also will test reducing dynamic batching window (6ms -> 3ms) to see latency tail tradeoff — batching heuristics might amplify the regression when pager latency spikes.

olga: also add model-specific selector override: for mistral-7b force amx when rotary_dim detection ambiguous. For qwen/mixtral leave current policy. We should add an opt-in map in kernel_selector config.

marco: brief note on RoPE scaling: when RoPE dims scale non-linearly across heads, the kernel decision logic needs to consider "rotary dim density" (rotary_dim / total_head_dim). That ratio pushed us into a suboptimal kernel for some models.

sam: action items:
1) olga: revert kernel flip for mistral-7b on staging + add selector override (PR).
2) jia: run KV grid (A/B/C) + batching window experiment, post results.
3) jia: patch pager to coalesce adjacent pages and reduce eviction churn (small change, low risk).
4) marco: update perf dashboard with per-model kernel selection column and add regression alert for mismatched selector decisions.

olga: taking 1 and the selector work now. will link PR in thread. :thumbsup:

jia: starting grid runs — estimate ~8h. I'll dump results here.

perf-bot: perf-bot: scheduled run queued: run-0912-grid-kv (priority: high).

sam: thanks. if layout tweak (A or C) recovers >10% we can keep the kernel change and tune kv layout permanently. otherwise we revert.

marco: keeping thread open until grid completes. will follow up with dashboard update.

sam: ping me if you need extra stubs to reproduce locally.

jia: will attach perf artifacts when runs finish.

sam: sounds good — leaving this as active work. :eyes:
